_about: Cicero in English, translator per title. Orations: C. D. Yonge (Bohn), 4 vols. (vols. 1-3 raw IA, vol. 4 clean Gutenberg). Philosophy: Yonge's Academics, De Finibus, Tusculans (with a sketch of the Greek philosophers) and his Tusculans, Nature of the Gods and Commonwealth; Shuckburgh's Friendship and Old Age; Peabody's De Amicitia and Scipio's Dream; Featherstonhaugh's Republic. Rhetoric: E. Jones's Brutus and Orator. Letters: Shuckburgh's whole extant correspondence (vol. 1 clean Gutenberg, vols. 2-4 raw IA) and his selection. Walter Miller's Loeb De Officiis (Gutenberg; Latin facing kept) added 2026-10-02 from the bilingual catalogue. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives. Added 2026-10-03, older translations as raw IA OCR: William Guthrie's Epistles to Atticus (vol. I of the 1752 edition; vols. II-III of the corrected 1806 edition), his Offices with Cato, Laelius, Paradoxes and the Vision of Scipio (1755) and his On Oratory and Orators (1808, 2 vols., as amended by Jones); William Heberden's Letters to Atticus (1825, 2 vols.); Thomas Francklin's Nature of the Gods (1829); and G. E. Jeans's Life and Letters (2nd ed., 1887). Also William Melmoth's Letters to Several of His Friends, 1808 edition in five volumes, vols. II-V (vol. I, lettersofmarcust01ciceuoft, answers 500 and is on the hourly retry).
